title: Factorized module x position Mirror code
hypothesis: One shared phase per composition position lets a small module bank implement held-out ordered module compositions with less state than direct position coefficients and independent per-sequence modules.
physical_object: three 2x2 matrices reused at three ordered positions
mirror_coordinate: position-specific Givens phase shared across module identities
logical_multiplicity: 27 ordered triples, with held-out route combinations
controls: direct sine/cosine coefficient pair per position
fixture: All 27 ordered triples from three modules at three positions; hold out triples whose (a+2*b+3*c) mod 3 == 0. Shared target bank applies position-specific Givens conjugation; ReLU between stages makes order noncommutative.

development.selection_metric: held-out-order normalized MSE, actual bytes, MAC proxy and CPU decode+forward latency

fresh.run_only_if: not run: the development Mirror-specific byte and attribution gates failed

compute.timing_boundary: decode position Views and evaluate 27 orders on the same query batch

success_gate: Held-out order nMSE<=1e-6; Mirror payload<=0.90x direct coefficient payload and <=0.50x independent payload; decode+forward compute<=1.5x direct coefficient.
failure_gate: Any development quality/storage miss or exact direct-control alias.
boundaries: Synthetic fixed module bank; no learned router or training.
Ordered routes are serialized and charged; no routing-learning claim.
Do not call the 27 triples independent capacity.
